note: Oct 7: compose, stance, extract, extract_flash and view_enrich run on the official Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com, native generateContent, x-goog-api-key; token = regex AQ\.\S+ inside env GEMINI_API_KEY, never logged). Default model gemini-3-flash-preview (cheap) for stance / extract / extract_flash / view_enrich; compose defaults to gemini-3.1-pro-preview since Oct 7 fix26 (Fiona's review of the 26 flash drafts). Other models stay available: FD_GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.1-pro-preview switches every Gemini stage, FD_<STAGE>_MODEL switches one stage (route and max_tokens kept). No fallback: a Gemini failure (quota, 5xx, unset key) raises; nothing silently moves to Opus. The micuapi relay (GEMINI_RELAY_API_KEY) is no longer used by any stage. default (legacy translation/localization stages) stays claude-opus-5 on the erisedai relay. max_tokens: Gemini thinking tokens count toward the ceiling. rates = official list prices per 1M tokens (input, output), local estimates, not invoices. Oct 7 smoke: at temperature 0 Gemini 3 flash looped in thinking (~15.4k thought tokens, max_tokens reached); Gemini stages therefore run at temperature 1.0 (Google default for Gemini 3) with thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel=medium (~2k thought tokens per compose). FD_GEMINI_THINKING=low|medium|high overrides.
